patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than Cognism's shape. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Clearbit's shape. Workflow advantage: Clearbit leans shared coverage; Cognism leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir; Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale.
- Company-size focus: Clearbit (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Cognism (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clearbit-leaning — vs Cognism-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach.

Limitations — Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+; Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing.

Poor-fit cases: Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Avoid Clearbit if you actually need Cognism's motion (Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobile)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
